title: 5 mistakes beginners make with AI tools

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What are the most common pitfalls beginners face when adopting AI tools today?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: They overestimate AI's capabilities, like expecting perfect language models without training or data alignment.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Misuse of AI in areas like deepfakes or biased algorithms can erode trust and reinforce harmful stereotypes.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are creating guardrails, like bias-detection tools and explainability features, to mitigate these issues.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: With responsible AI frameworks, we could see more inclusive, transparent systems that benefit everyone.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future lies in balancing innovation with accountability — a path we’re just beginning to walk.

video_cue: A montage of diverse engineers and ethicists collaborating on AI projects in a modern innovation lab.
